evidence_summary: GAO found that FCRA and GLBA coverage was limited and recommended extending safeguarding duties to all sensitive personal information held even by information resellers; the broader Senate proposal remained legislation rather than an enacted generally applicable duty.
threshold_application: The frozen threshold required a generally applicable duty in force, not sectoral duties or an introduced bill. That condition was not met by the deadline.
conflict_or_missing_application: Sector-specific safeguards existed, but they do not satisfy the frozen population. GAO's contemporaneous review supplies affirmative evidence of the gap rather than inference from silence.
notes: Prediction scored against federal/general US coverage, consistent with its frozen wording.

evidence_summary: Intel identifies Knights Landing as the first AVX-512 implementation and lists the qualifying Xeon Phi 7250 launch in Q2 2016.
threshold_application: The first qualifying physical implementation arrived after 7 August 2015, so the explicit deadline was missed.
conflict_or_missing_application: Pre-release specifications, emulators and announcements are excluded by the frozen requirement for physical hardware shipping or publicly available.
notes: Intel ARK and Intel's AVX-512 technical page are mutually consistent.

evidence_summary: Contemporaneous evidence estimates 205.6 billion emails per day worldwide and documents commercial archives at petabyte scale, but no located product documentation explicitly claims capacity to store all worldwide email traffic.
threshold_application: Neither the frozen success threshold—an explicitly documented all-world-email product—nor its contradiction threshold is established.
conflict_or_missing_application: Absence of a located marketing or technical claim is not evidence that no qualifying commercial system existed; the preregistered missing-evidence rule therefore requires indeterminate.
notes: Capacity calculations were not substituted for the required explicit capability statement.

evidence_summary: NHS Digital and India's official botnet-cleaning centre documented the Silex worm spreading against IoT devices in June 2019 and compromising them through default Telnet credentials.
threshold_application: One documented in-the-wild 2019 campaign using a named frozen mechanism is sufficient; Silex directly satisfies occurrence, target, mechanism and year.
conflict_or_missing_application: Two independent governmental technical advisories agree; no material conflict remains.
notes: The evidence describes active spreading and affected devices, not a proof of concept.

evidence_summary: The Dutch Electoral Council published the official results of the advisory referendum on the Intelligence and Security Services Act, recording votes cast in that referendum.
threshold_application: The official national vote occurred on the exact predicted date, 21 March 2018.
conflict_or_missing_application: An authoritative election record directly establishes the event; no conflicting evidence.
notes: Exact-date prediction fulfilled.

evidence_summary: A 2006 disclosure affected the then-new Skype 2.0 URI handler and allowed an authorized remote party to cause arbitrary file downloads, but the located primary records do not establish code execution, credential theft or unauthorized message/session access. Other located IM flaws either affected established products or were disclosed after 2006.
threshold_application: The closest qualifying-new-service evidence does not meet one of the frozen security impacts, while the search did not establish that no other qualifying disclosure existed.
conflict_or_missing_application: Because the contradiction rule calls for a comprehensive review and the historical disclosure record is incomplete, the case remains indeterminate rather than a presumed miss.
notes: A broad CVE-family search should be independently replicated before final lock.

evidence_summary: Contemporaneous technical reporting documents CommWarrior variants actively propagating phone-to-phone by Bluetooth and MMS during 2006; retrospective incident material reports infections across more than 30 countries and a corporate mass-infection event.
threshold_application: Cross-country and organizational infection evidence greatly exceeds the frozen minimum of ten independently operated phones, and propagation was autonomous from infected phones.
conflict_or_missing_application: Although the family originated in 2005, the prediction required qualifying spread during 2006 rather than a newly created family; the evidence covers 2006 variants and incidents.
notes: The USENIX slide deck corroborates real-world breadth; the Scientific American article supplies contemporaneous mechanism and observed-device context.

evidence_summary: The major 2006 Apple security advisories document many flaws delivered through Software Update, including code-execution issues in Mail, Safari and iChat, but the located evidence does not identify the Mac OS X update mechanism or its trust path as the vulnerable component.
threshold_application: Being patched by Software Update is explicitly insufficient under the frozen rule; no qualifying update-mechanism disclosure was established for 2006.
conflict_or_missing_application: The distinction between a vulnerable updater and vulnerabilities distributed as updates resolves the apparent positive evidence. Historical absence is coded as non-fulfilment under the row's frozen rule.
notes: Mozilla's separate 2006 auto-update vulnerability was not counted because the population was specifically Mac OS X's mechanism.

evidence_summary: Germany enacted the telecommunications-surveillance and data-retention reform, made fingerprint-bearing electronic passports operational, and activated the central inter-agency counterterrorism database on 30 March 2007.
threshold_application: Telecommunications retention/interception, biometric identity/travel and intelligence-law-enforcement databases are three distinct frozen domains with enacted or operational expansion.
conflict_or_missing_application: Each domain is supported by an official legal or parliamentary record; proposals were not counted.
notes: The passport regulation and Bundestag record provide additional official corroboration.

evidence_summary: The BKA demonstrated an internally developing Remote Forensic Software concept in 2007, but contemporaneous reporting states that the technology was not mature and that the necessary legal basis was still absent.
threshold_application: A development-stage demonstration is expressly insufficient; no operational use or official procurement by the BKA was established by year end.
conflict_or_missing_application: State-level contracts and later BKA capabilities were excluded under the frozen agency and deadline rules.
notes: Scored as a miss rather than crediting near-completion.

evidence_summary: Procurement records reported from tender documents show the Baden-Württemberg state criminal police contracted DigiTask in December 2007 for a €1.2 million telecommunications-surveillance application.
threshold_application: A German public authority contracted an external private supplier for a material covert interception component before year end.
conflict_or_missing_application: The frozen claim is not limited to the BKA. The contract is specific to surveillance technology, rather than generic IT consulting.
notes: Evidence is documentary reporting of tender records; retrieval of the underlying award file would strengthen replication.

evidence_summary: No reproducible frozen-equivalent CVE query or curated dataset was located that consistently counts exploitable graphics, wireless-chipset, peripheral-firmware and comparable non-IP component disclosures in both years.
threshold_application: The required direction comparison cannot be calculated without post hoc category judgments that would materially alter the frozen indicator.
conflict_or_missing_application: The missing-data rule requires the same query and inclusion rules for both years; ad hoc examples cannot establish a count trend.
notes: Requires a separately reproducible historical CVE ontology exercise.

evidence_summary: The audit located no verifiable 2007 case of a consumer VoIP, IPTV or dedicated media set-top appliance operating as botnet infrastructure or a Tor node; nearby cases involve general-purpose computers or later router botnets.
threshold_application: No qualifying occurrence was established by the deadline.
conflict_or_missing_application: Because the row's frozen rule treats absence as non-fulfilment, later or non-appliance cases were not used to rescue the prediction.
notes: Low evidence strength: historical device-botnet coverage is incomplete.

evidence_summary: The Full Disclosure archive is accessible, but 'bogus advisory' has no stable archive label and a reliable 2006-versus-2007 event count would require subjective full-corpus coding and cross-post deduplication.
threshold_application: The frozen comparative threshold was not computable from archive metadata alone.
conflict_or_missing_application: Because comparable archive completeness and classification could not be demonstrated, the explicit missing-data rule mandates indeterminate.
notes: Do not substitute total message volume or isolated hoaxes for the frozen bogus-event count.

evidence_summary: The closest 2007 filesystem record found concerns remote RPC handling in HP-UX PFS, not code execution triggered by mounting or parsing attacker-controlled removable media. Later removable-filesystem research identifies the relevant class but not a qualifying 2007 disclosure.
threshold_application: No 2007 disclosure met the frozen trigger and impact together.
conflict_or_missing_application: Document parser, Autorun and remotely invoked filesystem-service bugs were excluded as preregistered; absence is non-fulfilment under the row rule.
notes: Moderate confidence pending a reproducible NVD filesystem-component query.

evidence_summary: The European Commission's final privacy and RFID recommendation was published on 12 May 2009.
threshold_application: Publication occurred nearly eleven months after the frozen 20 June 2008 deadline.
conflict_or_missing_application: Draft consultation material before the deadline was excluded exactly as preregistered.
notes: Correct institution and instrument, wrong date.

evidence_summary: Contemporaneous model histories show radar- or laser-based collision assistance confined to selected premium models and early introductions; broad standardization and mass-market penetration occurred much later.
threshold_application: No major market approached the frozen greater-than-50% share of new registrations or model lines by December 2008.
conflict_or_missing_application: Ultrasonic parking aids and camera-only systems were excluded. Available historical model evidence is sufficient to reject majority prevalence, although no single census covers every model line.
notes: The threshold was deliberately stringent; isolated Honda, Toyota, Mercedes, Volvo and similar systems do not satisfy it.

evidence_summary: Public 2008 disclosures affected at least CitectSCADA and DATAC RealWin, two distinct industrial control products; both included remotely reachable buffer-overflow impacts and Citect was rated high with complete-control consequences.
threshold_application: Two distinct product disclosures plus a high-impact case satisfy the frozen worsening proxy.
conflict_or_missing_application: The evidence concerns process-control products rather than office IT and uses initial 2008 disclosure records.
notes: NIST's 2008 ICS security publications corroborate the contemporaneous exposure context.

evidence_summary: Researchers publicly demonstrated wireless attacks against an implantable cardiac device and a complete cryptanalytic break affecting KeeLoq-based vehicle and building access controllers in 2008.
threshold_application: Medical implants and vehicle/access-control components are two distinct unexpected embedded-device categories first publicly demonstrated that year.
conflict_or_missing_application: The attacks compromise embedded device functions or trust mechanisms; mere barcode manipulation and ordinary routers are not counted.
notes: Two peer-reviewed or university primary research lines satisfy category breadth.

evidence_summary: Adobe issued at least three separate critical 2008 Flash-related advisories or clusters, including APSA08-03, APSA08-08/APSB08-18 and APSA08-09; the Flash Player clickjacking issue affected all supported platforms.
threshold_application: The count reaches three distinct critical clusters and includes cross-platform Flash Player exposure.
conflict_or_missing_application: Separate disclosures were counted once each; multiple CVEs inside one bulletin were not inflated.
notes: Adobe's archived bulletin index and APSB08-24 provide corroborating year-end security updates.

evidence_summary: Microsoft documents Koobface spreading through both MySpace and Facebook, while contemporaneous reporting records expansion to Bebo and other social networks during 2008.
threshold_application: Automated propagation on at least two distinct social-network services directly meets the threshold.
conflict_or_missing_application: This is cross-service behavior, not merely cross-operating-system execution or copied proof-of-concept code.
notes: Strong vendor evidence for the two-platform minimum.

evidence_summary: Hosted university email adoption was widespread internationally in 2008, but the located deployment lists do not establish production adoption by two distinct publicly governed German institutions before year end.
threshold_application: The frozen Germany-specific two-institution threshold is neither met nor contradicted by the available evidence.
conflict_or_missing_application: International universities and mere consideration of hosting were excluded; historical German procurement and deployment records remain incomplete.
notes: Requires German institutional archive research rather than inference from global Google Apps adoption.

evidence_summary: Individual Mac malware families and samples are documented in both years, but no located source provides a stable same-taxonomy family or sample series for 2007 and 2008.
threshold_application: The required direction cannot be computed reproducibly from anecdotes or later undeduplicated lists.
conflict_or_missing_application: The frozen rule requires comparable series and majority agreement if several exist; missing comparable denominators mandate indeterminate.
notes: Do not substitute total detections or press salience for distinct-family counts.

evidence_summary: No qualifying 2008 malicious-code family or port linking iPhone OS and Mac OS X was documented. The first widely documented iPhone worms appeared in 2009, while later cross-platform families such as WireLurker appeared years afterward.
threshold_application: The deadline passed without a qualifying sample satisfying target, malicious-code status and shared code or lineage.
conflict_or_missing_application: Benign jailbreak tools and browser exploits were excluded under the frozen rule; later iPhone or Mac-linked malware cannot satisfy 2008.
notes: Moderate confidence based on platform security histories and malware chronologies.

evidence_summary: The Privacy Rights Clearinghouse chronology contains well over five distinct 2009 incidents exceeding 100,000 personal records, including Health Net, National Archives media, Virginia health-professions data and other large non-card-only events.
threshold_application: Deduplicated qualifying incidents exceed the frozen minimum of five and each crosses 100,000 records.
conflict_or_missing_application: Payment-card-only cases were excluded; the result remains above threshold using events involving names, health, Social Security or other personal data.
notes: A reproducible extract of the evolving PRC database should be archived with the final replication package.

evidence_summary: At 26C3, Karsten Nohl and collaborators publicly released distributed A5/1 cracking tables and presented a practical attack path against deployed GSM confidentiality using independently obtainable radio data and tools.
threshold_application: The public tables and accompanying artifacts constitute a reproducible deployed-network attack by 31 December 2009.
conflict_or_missing_application: Earlier expensive demonstrations were not needed; the 26C3 release supplies the required public artifacts and independent-researcher availability.
notes: Exact conference-deadline hit.

evidence_summary: The audit located examples of geographic-circumvention proxy and VPN growth but not three independent like-for-like series or one authoritative global series measuring qualifying circumvention use in both 2008 and 2009.
threshold_application: The frozen 25% majority or 50% global threshold cannot be calculated.
conflict_or_missing_application: Corporate VPN counts and total Tor users were not silently treated as geographic-filter bypass usage; incompatible definitions require indeterminate.
notes: Historical commercial VPN market estimates do not isolate the frozen purpose.

evidence_summary: Adobe's 2009 bulletins and NVD records document more than five distinct high-severity Flash Player vulnerabilities across the year's update clusters; CVE-2009-1862 was exploited in the wild through crafted SWF/PDF content.
threshold_application: The vulnerability count exceeds five and the active-exploitation alternative is directly satisfied.
conflict_or_missing_application: Distinct CVEs/root causes were counted, not repeated notices for the same patch; ordinary webcam APIs were not counted.
notes: Adobe APSB09-10 and APSB09-19 provide the principal multi-CVE clusters.

evidence_summary: The prominent multi-vendor SNMPv3 authentication weakness was publicly disclosed in 2008; Cisco's January 2009 revision added affected products but did not create five distinct 2009 disclosure or incident events. The audit did not identify five qualifying new events in 2009.
threshold_application: The frozen minimum of five was not reached; one to four events are explicitly non-fulfilment.
conflict_or_missing_application: Duplicate vendor advisories and revisions for VU#878044 were treated as one underlying flaw.
notes: Moderate confidence; a full NVD component query could further document the negative count.

evidence_summary: Documented activist balloon-mapping campaigns meeting the predicted imaging-platform concept become visible in 2010 and later; the audit found no evidence of ten separate 2009 deployments across three campaigns or organizations.
threshold_application: The very high frozen breadth threshold was not met in 2009.
conflict_or_missing_application: Military surveillance balloons, static propaganda balloons without imaging or communications payloads and the DARPA prize balloons themselves were excluded.
notes: A few isolated actions would still score as a miss under the preregistered ten-deployment rule.

evidence_summary: GhostNet provides strong evidence of extensive targeted attacks against Tibetan institutions, NGOs, media and other high-value targets disclosed in 2009, but no comparable series supplies a consistently coded 2008 denominator and 2009 numerator.
threshold_application: Salient 2009 campaigns do not alone establish the frozen 25% year-on-year increase in a majority of series.
conflict_or_missing_application: Campaign counts cannot be reconstructed without post hoc scope choices; therefore the direction claim is indeterminate.
notes: This distinction prevents a famous event from being treated as proof of trend magnitude.

evidence_summary: The GhostNet investigation documented tailored malicious email and malware operations against Tibetan institutions and a broader network of 1,295 infected hosts in 103 countries, including many NGOs, media and governmental organizations.
threshold_application: A shared group-selective campaign affected far more than five organizations and was publicly documented in 2009.
conflict_or_missing_application: The campaign used targeted lures and payloads rather than language-only mass spam; multiple victims are part of one qualifying event.
notes: The threshold asks for one campaign, so no year-on-year denominator is needed.

evidence_summary: Yxes/Sexy Space was an in-the-wild signed Symbian worm and mobile botnet that spread through SMS links and affected users in China and the Middle East, but located sources do not establish 10,000 devices or operation across three specifically documented countries or networks.
threshold_application: Occurrence and mechanism are proven, while the frozen scale threshold is not.
conflict_or_missing_application: Incomparable and unquantified telemetry triggers indeterminate rather than inferring substantial population from press descriptions.
notes: A later Fortinet technical paper may permit a stronger scale judgment if raw telemetry is recoverable.

evidence_summary: The Commission issued an RFID privacy recommendation in May 2009 and a separate Internet of Things action plan as Communication COM(2009)278. The recommendation itself addresses RFID applications but does not materially or explicitly constitute an IoT recommendation.
threshold_application: No Commission recommendation explicitly addressing IoT was published by the deadline; the IoT instrument was a communication, not a recommendation.
conflict_or_missing_application: The frozen rule expressly forbids silently equating the RFID recommendation with an IoT recommendation. Correct instrument type controls the judgment.
notes: Substantive policy activity occurred, but the explicit predicted document type did not.

evidence_summary: Germany's federal data-protection commissioner explicitly connected smart-meter energy-efficiency objectives with privacy risks and design requirements in 2010, and academic interventions framed the same conflict. The audit did not verify three independent authoritative interventions within the calendar year.
threshold_application: The substance and visibility of the conflict are proven, but the frozen breadth threshold of three authoritative interventions is not securely met.
conflict_or_missing_application: Later 2011-2012 legal scholarship, WP29 and EDPS opinions were excluded from the 2010 window; uncertainty in independence requires indeterminate.
notes: A targeted search of all German state data-protection commissioner archives could resolve this hold.

evidence_summary: Multiple 2010 studies demonstrated that fine-grained whole-house electricity traces permit inference of appliance use and complex household activity patterns; contemporaneous NILM work experimentally disaggregated appliance operation.
threshold_application: At least two appliance or activity classes were inferred from granular data, satisfying the occurrence threshold.
conflict_or_missing_application: Monthly aggregate billing was not counted; the cited work uses fine-grained demand traces and statistical disaggregation.
notes: Peer-reviewed primary research directly matches the predicted privacy mechanism.

evidence_summary: Public reporting contains individual fraud-alert card blocks and precautionary replacements, but the audit did not establish three independent large-scale 2010 incidents in which automated scoring materially selected the affected population.
threshold_application: The frozen three-incident threshold cannot be distinguished from ordinary breach-driven mass replacement on available evidence.
conflict_or_missing_application: Cases where a known breach alone determined replacement were excluded; missing documentation of automation requires indeterminate.
notes: Bank operational opacity makes historical false-positive attribution particularly weak.

evidence_summary: The IETF's residential IPv6 security guidance codified simple security and stateful filtering for customer-premises routers, reflecting the prevailing practice of blocking unsolicited inbound traffic even when endpoints held global addresses.
threshold_application: No documented deployment-weighted sample showed more than half of consumer or mobile IPv6 endpoints directly reachable inbound by year end.
conflict_or_missing_application: Global addressing was not equated with reachability; the frozen rule explicitly excludes endpoints behind stateful firewalls.
notes: The prediction's architectural intuition missed the default-firewall layer.

evidence_summary: Public leak platforms released numerous distinct datasets in 2010, including Collateral Murder, the Afghan War Diary, the Iraq War Logs, Cablegate, the Reykjavik/Icesave cable and additional independently sourced institutional records.
threshold_application: At least five non-mirror datasets were released, exceeding the frozen recurring-phenomenon threshold.
conflict_or_missing_application: The four major Manning-derived collections were treated as distinct underlying datasets as permitted by the rule, and independent smaller-source releases make the result robust to grouping them more conservatively.
notes: WikiLeaks alone is sufficient; mirrors were not counted.

evidence_summary: CVE's historical quarterly series and Secunia's contemporary statistics show that vulnerability volume in 2011 was below earlier peaks; Secunia counted 14% fewer CVE-linked vulnerabilities in all of 2011 than 2010 and 24% fewer than 2006.
threshold_application: The first half of 2011 did not exceed every earlier half-year in a consistent global series.
conflict_or_missing_application: The conclusion uses publication-period counts, not later assignment-year labels; no equally comprehensive catalog supports a record.
notes: Strong directional contradiction despite database backfill caveats.

evidence_summary: The CCC published binaries and two technical analyses of German source-interception malware in October 2011; ensuing admissions documented multiple deployments in Bavaria and other states, alongside separate parliamentary, legal and data-protection investigations.
threshold_application: Distinct deployments plus technical disclosures and accountability proceedings exceed five events, with primary technical artifacts satisfying the source requirement.
conflict_or_missing_application: Repeated press stories about one binary were deduplicated; separate target deployments and state proceedings count under the frozen rule.
notes: This prediction strongly fulfilled both occurrence and salience.

evidence_summary: The United States FBI publicly advanced modernization of lawful-intercept obligations for Internet services, and the United Kingdom continued its Communications Capabilities Development Programme. The audit did not establish a third distinct qualifying 2011 initiative across the required institutions or jurisdictions.
threshold_application: Two identifiable initiatives fall short of the frozen minimum of three.
conflict_or_missing_application: General cybercrime proposals without an access, attribution or encryption-control mechanism were excluded; later UK draft legislation from 2012 and later encryption debates do not qualify.
notes: Near miss: the policy direction was real but the preregistered breadth threshold was not reached.

evidence_summary: Brazil's Chamber of Deputies formally considered Bill 3133/2012, a broad copyright-law reform whose official Chamber account explicitly says it was prepared with suggestions from FGV's Center for Technology and Society.
threshold_application: A qualifying FGV-linked bill was introduced and under parliamentary consideration before 27 January 2013.
conflict_or_missing_application: The institutional linkage is stated by the legislature itself; later ECAD legislation was not needed to satisfy the threshold.
notes: Clear fulfilment several months before the deadline.

evidence_summary: The search found attacks and implementation weaknesses affecting authentication systems, but did not isolate a 2012 primary technical disclosure in which the hardware banking token itself was the practical bypass path under the frozen definition.
threshold_application: Available records cannot establish the required qualifying disclosure.
conflict_or_missing_application: Server-side banking compromises and social engineering that merely solicit a token code were excluded.
notes: Historical product opacity prevents a defensible binary judgment.

evidence_summary: Public lock-security demonstrations existed in 2012, but the audit could not verify three distinct marketed product families, each using an already-known weak smart-card technology, from preserved primary technical material.
threshold_application: The frozen three-family threshold remains unverified.
conflict_or_missing_application: Multiple locks sharing one underlying product family or newly discovered weaknesses were not counted twice.
notes: Conference-video survival is insufficient for reliable product-family coding.

evidence_summary: HID documented NFC-enabled Galaxy S III phones storing provisioned credentials and opening enterprise doors in completed Netflix and Good Technology pilots; ASSA ABLOY separately described its commercial Seos mobile-access solution.
threshold_application: At least one commercially supplied handset-and-reader system was deployed for real physical access by year end.
conflict_or_missing_application: The pilots involved actual workplace doors and users, not a laboratory-only demonstration.
notes: Strong contemporary vendor evidence with named deployment sites.

evidence_summary: Contemporary releases show growth in signed-boot and store-restricted devices, but no preserved source supplies a reproducible, fixed-vendor product-family census for both 2011 and 2012.
threshold_application: The required year-over-year count cannot be calculated under identical coding rules.
conflict_or_missing_application: Anecdotal prominence and unit sales were not substituted for the preregistered family count.
notes: The prediction is plausible but its frozen trend test is not recoverable.

evidence_summary: Major contemporaneous spam reviews describe attachment, link, obfuscation and social-engineering techniques but document no campaign using valid PGP encryption or signatures principally to evade content filters.
threshold_application: No qualifying campaign was identified in broad 2012 spam reporting.
conflict_or_missing_application: Ordinary encrypted transport, password-protected archives and spoofed signature blocks were excluded.
notes: Non-fulfilment rests on broad specialist coverage rather than proof of universal absence.

evidence_summary: The audit found no documented material provider that blocked encrypted mail by default in 2012 together with evidence that users consequently suppressed or abandoned encrypted communication.
threshold_application: Neither a complete qualifying paired event nor its behavioral consequence was documented.
conflict_or_missing_application: Generic attachment blocking and inability to inspect encrypted payloads do not satisfy the two-part rule without measured or reported abandonment.
notes: The causal behavioral element makes this a clear threshold miss in the available record.

evidence_summary: Samsung's mass-market Galaxy S II, Note and S III incorporated Sensory's low-power TrulyHandsfree trigger; contemporary documentation describes the system as always-on and always-listening and activated by the phrase 'Hi Galaxy.'
threshold_application: A qualifying mass-market handset family with continuous local trigger detection was released in 2012.
conflict_or_missing_application: The trigger detector, rather than continuous cloud recording, is the capability frozen by the prediction.
notes: Fulfilled earlier than the better-known 2013 Moto X implementation.

evidence_summary: Many prominent privacy disputes occurred in both years, but no preregistered archive or reproducible search frame yields comparable deduplicated controversy counts for 2011 and 2012.
threshold_application: The required year-over-year comparison cannot be reconstructed reliably.
conflict_or_missing_application: News volume and subjective prominence were not treated as counts of distinct controversies.
notes: A broad and elastic outcome defeats stable retrospective enumeration.

evidence_summary: ICANN delegated the first four non-Latin new gTLDs in October 2013 and published operational root-query analyses, but the preserved 2013 material does not show one of those newly delegated IDN labels in an enterprise SIEM, DNS or security log after delegation.
threshold_application: Delegation alone does not meet the frozen operational-log-example threshold.
conflict_or_missing_application: DITL observations of applied-for strings before delegation and existing IDN country-code domains were excluded as specified.
notes: Near fulfilment, but the prediction deliberately required the observable logging consequence.

evidence_summary: Interactive calculation-bearing government PDF forms were widespread, especially in tax and benefits workflows, but the audit could not document ten distinct authorities across three jurisdictions with preserved primary files and qualifying script behavior.
threshold_application: The numerical and jurisdictional threshold remains unverified.
conflict_or_missing_application: Static fillable PDFs and third-party form mirrors were excluded; present-day files cannot prove the feature existed by the deadline.
notes: Web-archive loss prevents a defensible authority-level census.

evidence_summary: Germany enacted a uniform Federal Registration Act, but the operative design retained municipal registration authorities and federated register queries rather than proposing consolidation into a federal population database or centralized federal access service.
threshold_application: No qualifying federal consolidation or centralized-access proposal was identified by year end.
conflict_or_missing_application: A nationally uniform legal framework was not equated with a centralized population register.
notes: The forecast conflated federal legislation with federal data centralization.

evidence_summary: Systematic 2013 mobile-malware and threat-landscape reviews cover SMS fraud, banking theft, surveillance, botnets and privilege abuse but report no deployed malware hijacking a context-aware mobile assistant's query or recommendation output.
threshold_application: The required negative condition holds across broad contemporaneous threat coverage.
conflict_or_missing_application: Generic search redirection and adware were excluded unless they intercepted an assistant-specific contextual exchange.
notes: Moderate rather than strong because absence can only be established through coverage.

evidence_summary: The FDA issued a June 2013 safety communication and draft premarket cybersecurity guidance. Independent 2013 research, specialist reporting and government exercises generated well over five substantive items across multiple sources concerning networked implants, pumps and hospital devices.
threshold_application: The regulator communication plus the frozen five-item and three-source salience thresholds were met.
conflict_or_missing_application: Repeated reports of one demonstration were deduplicated; the FDA actions, distinct device research and separate government exercise coverage remain sufficient.
notes: A clear agenda-setting year for medical-device cybersecurity.

evidence_summary: Records discuss validation burdens and patching constraints for medical and industrial systems, but the audit could not verify three distinct 2013 records spanning two safety-critical sectors that explicitly make the required causal link.
threshold_application: The cross-sector three-record threshold remains unverified.
conflict_or_missing_application: General claims that legacy systems are hard to patch were excluded unless certification, safety approval or a qualified configuration was expressly identified.
notes: The phenomenon is credible but the exact 2013 evidentiary bundle is incomplete.

evidence_summary: The only material copyright measure adopted by the deadline was the narrowly scoped collective-rights-management directive; no broad reform of EU copyright's substantive exclusive rights, limitations or digital-market framework was finally adopted.
threshold_application: The preregistered negative condition held through 30 June 2014.
conflict_or_missing_application: Consultations and pending proposals were excluded because the rule required final adoption; the 2014 directive did not meet the frozen substantive-reform definition.
notes: The later Digital Single Market reform falls outside the horizon.

evidence_summary: A model-level census identified fingerprint phones from Samsung, Huawei, Meizu, Oppo and several smaller Asian vendors, but fewer than ten clearly qualifying 2014 announcements could be verified across five non-Apple manufacturers.
threshold_application: The combined ten-model and five-manufacturer threshold was not met on classifiable contemporary records.
conflict_or_missing_application: 2013 announcements, tablets, later regional variants and duplicate carrier versions were excluded.
notes: Adoption accelerated, but the frozen threshold was intentionally demanding.

evidence_summary: SRLabs reproducibly bypassed the Galaxy S5 fingerprint reader with a lifted-print spoof, but the audit found no second distinct non-Apple smartphone introduced in 2014 with a qualifying public bypass by year end.
threshold_application: One verified model falls short of the required two.
conflict_or_missing_application: Repetition of the Galaxy S5 demonstration and attacks on Apple's 2013 iPhone were deduplicated or excluded.
notes: A precise one-model near miss.

evidence_summary: Major 2014 fingerprint smartphones stored and matched templates in protected on-device environments; Samsung explicitly stated each device encrypted its fingerprint data so even Samsung could not decode it. No majority using remote cloud matching was documented.
threshold_application: The remote-matching share was not above 50 percent and the dominant classifiable architecture was local.
conflict_or_missing_application: Cloud account use and remote payment authorization were not equated with transmitting fingerprint templates for matching.
notes: Strong directional contradiction to the predicted architecture.

evidence_summary: UEFI firmware was standard at major PC OEMs and supported updateable components, but preserved 2014 product documentation did not establish post-manufacture loadable modules as a promoted capability of a newly introduced product line.
threshold_application: The exact product-line and promoted-capability threshold remains unverified.
conflict_or_missing_application: Routine whole-firmware updates and internal modular architecture were excluded.
notes: Technically plausible but not evidenced at the frozen marketing/documentation level.

evidence_summary: 2014 produced important acoustic and electromagnetic leakage demonstrations, but the audit could not confirm three independent teams recovering cryptographic secrets or authentication credentials across two qualifying channel categories within the calendar year.
threshold_application: The three-team, two-category conjunction remains unverified.
conflict_or_missing_application: Device fingerprinting and exfiltration without recovery of a secret or credential were excluded.
notes: Salience rose, but the preregistered evidentiary bundle is incomplete.

evidence_summary: Independent research showed that unpermissioned smartphone motion sensors could infer sensitive user input and uniquely fingerprint devices, causing sensor access to be treated as a security and credential-exposure problem.
threshold_application: The research branch was met by multiple independent teams by year end.
conflict_or_missing_application: Pure activity recognition was excluded; qualifying work demonstrated security-relevant inference or identification.
notes: Fulfilled through research even without a major platform mitigation.

evidence_summary: Baseband research disclosed serious modem attack surfaces in 2014, but the audit could not verify a remotely exploitable flaw, a public practical demonstration and authoritative exposure of at least one million deployed devices in the same qualifying record.
threshold_application: The compound exploitability-and-scale threshold remains unverified.
conflict_or_missing_application: Local host-to-modem flaws, malicious-firmware assumptions and unquantified protocol weaknesses were excluded.
notes: The broad 'baseband apocalypse' narrative outruns the preserved 2014 evidence.

evidence_summary: Toyota commercialized ITS Connect on production vehicles in Japan in 2015, using dedicated short-range radio for vehicle-to-vehicle and vehicle-to-infrastructure safety communication.
threshold_application: At least one automaker commercially offered a qualifying factory-installed production model before the deadline.
conflict_or_missing_application: Forward announcements were corroborated by Toyota's later official commercialization record.
notes: Clear fulfilment at the deadline year.

evidence_summary: Windows 10 materially expanded automatic and, for consumer editions, effectively mandatory updating; the change generated sustained controversy across major technology and policy outlets within weeks of launch.
threshold_application: One major platform change and well over five reports across three independent sources occurred within a 90-day window.
conflict_or_missing_application: Coverage of telemetry alone was excluded; the qualifying controversy specifically concerned forced or non-consensual updates.
notes: A conspicuous and well-documented 2015 peak.

evidence_summary: Autonomous road vehicles received extensive 2015 attention from regulators, automakers, technology firms, professional bodies and general news, easily exceeding ten substantive items across five sources and multiple source types.
threshold_application: The frozen volume, source-diversity and source-type thresholds were exceeded.
conflict_or_missing_application: Driver-assistance stories were excluded unless they addressed automated driving as defined.
notes: A high-confidence salience outcome.

evidence_summary: Hotel Wi-Fi providers used captive portals, analytics and content injection, but the audit could not tie a named zero-price guest offering by the deadline to qualifying provider-side interception or an explicitly traffic-funded business model using preserved operational evidence.
threshold_application: The required named offering plus monetization/interception mechanism remains unverified.
conflict_or_missing_application: Hotels charging for access, blocking personal hotspots, or collecting ordinary registration details did not qualify by themselves.
notes: A plausible business practice with insufficient contemporaneous traceability.

evidence_summary: EU legislation required new vehicle types to carry eCall only from 31 March 2018. Before that mandate, deployments were optional and no evidence shows standard fitment in a majority of new models by December 2016.
threshold_application: The greater-than-50-percent standard-equipment threshold was not reached by the deadline.
conflict_or_missing_application: Optional proprietary emergency-call systems and future type approvals were not counted as standard EU eCall fitment.
notes: The prediction was roughly two years early.

evidence_summary: Flip Feng Shui demonstrated controlled cross-VM Rowhammer exploitation, while Drammer independently demonstrated deterministic Rowhammer exploitation on Android mobile devices.
threshold_application: Two distinct 2016 publications added new practical target classes and security impacts beyond the original work.
conflict_or_missing_application: Follow-up descriptions of the same exploit were deduplicated; cross-VM and mobile exploitation count separately.
notes: A clear continuation and diversification of Rowhammer.

evidence_summary: Contemporary smart-TV documentation and privacy analysis showed voice and viewing data flowing from mass-market televisions to the device maker, speech-processing vendors and advertising or analytics parties.
threshold_application: A named mass-market smart-TV class transmitted data to at least three organizationally distinct recipients including non-brand parties.
conflict_or_missing_application: Basic infrastructure endpoints were excluded; recipients performing speech, audience measurement or advertising functions were counted.
notes: Moderate because recipient mappings varied by model and region.

evidence_summary: Rather than a qualifying deterioration, enforceable EU open-internet rules took effect and India adopted strong rules against discriminatory data-service tariffs in 2016. No jurisdiction representing five percent of global users was shown repealing a safeguard that year.
threshold_application: Neither the jurisdictional weakening nor permitted paid-prioritization branch was met.
conflict_or_missing_application: Political proposals and later US repeal activity were excluded from the 2016 window.
notes: The forecast direction materialized later in the United States, not within its horizon.

evidence_summary: Apple litigated the FBI's demand to create bypass software, while Google, Microsoft, Facebook, Amazon and other major firms publicly opposed exceptional-access mandates and filed supporting briefs; the Burr-Feinstein encryption bill added a legislative branch.
threshold_application: Multiple major companies opposed the demands and the dispute generated both litigation and proposed national legislation.
conflict_or_missing_application: General privacy disputes were excluded; the evidence directly concerns compelled weakening or bypass of encryption.
notes: One of the corpus's most conspicuous fulfilments.

evidence_summary: The post-talk window ran from 7 October through 31 December 2016. A transaction search did not identify three distinct qualifying endpoint-security vendor acquisitions announced during that short interval.
threshold_application: Fewer than three qualifying acquisitions were announced after the talk and before year end.
conflict_or_missing_application: Deals announced before the talk, general network-security targets and minority investments were excluded.
notes: The directional consolidation claim was plausible but missed its unusually short frozen window.

evidence_summary: Global IPv6 use exceeded ten percent well before July 2017, and major fixed and mobile operators documented dual-stack production in which endpoints received globally routable IPv6 while retaining IPv4 service through provider or customer NAT.
threshold_application: The measurement threshold and the alternative major-operator-production branch were both met.
conflict_or_missing_application: IPv6 tunnels were excluded; the cited deployment reporting concerns native provider IPv6 alongside IPv4.
notes: A robust architectural transition prediction.

evidence_summary: Enterprise IPv6 deployment guides and validated designs consistently assigned global unicast addresses internally while prescribing route filtering, ACLs and perimeter policy to withhold external reachability from designated subnets.
threshold_application: At least five independently instantiated vendor or enterprise designs met both global-address and selective-nonpublic-routing elements.
conflict_or_missing_application: Stateful firewalling alone was not counted unless the design also specified routing or reachability policy.
notes: Moderate because several deployments inherit a common vendor reference design.

evidence_summary: Authenticated web proxies and identity-aware gateways were widely deployed, but preserved documentation rarely tied their identity correlation specifically to changing dual-stack IPv4/IPv6 addresses as the frozen rule requires.
threshold_application: Three explicit qualifying architectures could not be verified.
conflict_or_missing_application: Generic user-aware proxying without the dual-stack correlation rationale was excluded.
notes: The function existed, but the predicted causal framing is not recoverable.

evidence_summary: IPv6 deployment and responsive-address observations grew by far more than fivefold from 2012 to 2017, but comparable measurements do not reliably separate ordinary client or CPE endpoints from public server infrastructure.
threshold_application: The growth component is clear, but the frozen non-server endpoint classification cannot be established.
conflict_or_missing_application: Aggregate IPv6 adoption was not substituted for direct reachability of enterprise or consumer endpoints.
notes: Indeterminate due to population classification, not trend direction.

evidence_summary: IPv6-specific covert channels and evasion concepts were documented, but the audit found fewer than three independent practical demonstrations by July 2017 satisfying concealment, IPv6-specific dependence and monitoring-evasion requirements together.
threshold_application: The three-demonstration threshold was not met.
conflict_or_missing_application: Conceptual taxonomies, ordinary tunneling and encryption not dependent on IPv6 fields were excluded.
notes: The threat was technically real but less publicly demonstrated than predicted.

evidence_summary: RFC 7707, comprehensive-hitlist research and scanner practice explicitly state that exhaustive random or sequential IPv6 probing is infeasible and prescribe DNS, passive-flow, IPv4 correlation and address-pattern generation.
threshold_application: At least three authoritative sources supplied both the infeasibility finding and nonsequential alternatives.
conflict_or_missing_application: Scanning a known narrow prefix was not treated as exhaustive Internet reconnaissance.
notes: A precise technical forecast that clearly fulfilled.

evidence_summary: In February 2017 Cellebrite publicly stated that its Advanced Investigative Service could unlock and extract the full file system from iPhone 6 and 6 Plus devices, extending its previously documented forensic access.
threshold_application: A qualifying publicly documented capability existed within the nine-month window.
conflict_or_missing_application: The outcome is the capability to recover previously inaccessible user data; no claim that every passcode configuration was vulnerable is required.
notes: Fulfilled two months after the talk.

evidence_summary: Authoritative enterprise guidance documented material changes in address and identity management, perimeter filtering, reconnaissance and monitoring, DNS handling and dual-stack routing compared with conventional IPv4 designs.
threshold_application: At least three distinct changes were documented across standards guidance and multiple deployment-oriented architectures.
conflict_or_missing_application: Generic claims of modernization were excluded; only named control or topology changes counted.
notes: Fulfilled, though deployment evidence is less abundant than design guidance.

evidence_summary: By year end the sampled consumer platform families predominantly enabled security updates automatically by default, while government and vendor guidance endorsed prompt automatic updating as the secure baseline.
threshold_application: At least six of eight sampled families met the default-update rule and no comparable industry split opposed the principle.
conflict_or_missing_application: Disputes over timing, bandwidth and user control were distinguished from rejection of automatic security updating itself.
notes: The principle settled even though implementation controversies remained.

evidence_summary: Public filter lists used by mainstream ad blockers included rules for social widgets, newsletter prompts, cookie notices and other non-advertising page elements and user-interface content.
threshold_application: At least one operational and reproducible non-advertising content category was suppressed in 2017.
conflict_or_missing_application: Tracker blocking tied only to advertising was not needed; the annoyance and social lists directly satisfy the broader content criterion.
notes: Clear fulfilment through public version-controlled rules.

evidence_summary: ROBOT was publicly disclosed in December 2017 and presented at USENIX in 2018. Implementation advisories issued in 2018 largely concerned that same technique rather than a larger number of distinct newly disclosed adaptive-oracle attacks.
threshold_application: The deduplicated 2018 disclosure count did not exceed the 2017 count.
conflict_or_missing_application: Conference republication and multiple vendor CVEs for one root technique were deduplicated under the frozen rule.
notes: The apparent 2018 volume is sensitive to improperly counting downstream advisories.

evidence_summary: The search found software RNG and seeding defects in 2018 but no deduplicated increase in disclosed hardware RNG or hardware key-generation designs with demonstrably attack-enabling entropy failure relative to the prominent 2017 ROCA class.
threshold_application: The qualifying 2018 hardware-disclosure count did not exceed 2017.
conflict_or_missing_application: Software-only PRNG defects and theoretical distrust of hardware generators were excluded.
notes: Non-fulfilment is robust to excluding ambiguous firmware cases from both years.

evidence_summary: Public anti-anti-adblock scripts and frequently updated distributed filter lists defeated site detection logic, but the surviving record does not establish that an implementation used adaptive algorithmic decision-making rather than centrally maintained rules.
threshold_application: The anti-anti-adblock function is clear; the frozen adaptive-or-distributed-algorithmic element remains ambiguous.
conflict_or_missing_application: Ordinary subscription distribution and manual rule updates were not automatically treated as distributed computation or adaptation.
notes: A boundary case created by the prediction's strong algorithmic wording.

evidence_summary: AdVersarial publicly demonstrated adversarial examples and automated transformations that let publishers or ad networks evade perceptual and machine-learning ad blockers; the work included operational proof-of-concept attacks.
threshold_application: At least one publicly demonstrated adaptive automated evasion system existed by year end.
conflict_or_missing_application: Static HTML renaming alone was excluded; the qualifying work adapted inputs against learned detection pipelines.
notes: Fulfilled via demonstration, as the frozen rule allowed deployment or public demonstration.

evidence_summary: Cybersecurity startups emerged from research presented at Black Hat, but the audit could not verify three launches by the deadline whose central products were directly traceable to specific Black Hat USA 2017 research or problems.
threshold_application: The three-startup direct-link threshold remains unverified.
conflict_or_missing_application: Founder attendance, generic topic similarity and firms founded before the conference were excluded.
notes: Public startup narratives seldom preserve the required conference-level causal link.

evidence_summary: The endpoint market consolidated around EPP and EDR/XDR language, but the proprietary 451 Research taxonomy and its exact top-level category mapping could not be reconstructed at the deadline.
threshold_application: The comparable taxonomy's category count is unavailable.
conflict_or_missing_application: Gartner or vendor terminology was not substituted for the specifically named research taxonomy.
notes: Indeterminate because the outcome source is paywalled and historically mutable.

evidence_summary: Simple camera-based face unlock spread widely, but secure depth-based or equivalently strong real-time facial authentication comparable to iPhone X remained concentrated in Apple and a minority of premium Android models; fingerprint shipments remained dominant.
threshold_application: Qualifying models did not account for at least half of global 2019 smartphone shipments.
conflict_or_missing_application: Insecure 2D face unlock was excluded by the frozen comparability rule.
notes: The broad feature diffused, but not the predicted security-equivalent implementation.

evidence_summary: Programmable controllers were ubiquitous across appliances, toys, vehicles and entertainment devices, but no qualifying 2019 product sample covers four of five frozen categories with an eighty-percent denominator.
threshold_application: The required category-level prevalence evidence is missing.
conflict_or_missing_application: Examples and shipment totals for selected smart products were not extrapolated to all feature-bearing electrical products.
notes: Conceptually likely, empirically untestable at the frozen threshold.

evidence_summary: 2019 measurement and incident records document persistent local or cloud storage of telemetry from smart TVs, cameras and smart-home or wearable devices, among other mass-market categories.
threshold_application: At least three distinct mass-market device categories satisfied the persistent-storage rule.
conflict_or_missing_application: Transient network signaling alone was excluded; the cited systems retained viewing, device, account, video or sensor records.
notes: A high-confidence cross-category fulfilment.

evidence_summary: Distinct 2019 exposures affected connected cameras and home sensors (Wyze), a multi-category smart-home platform (Orvibo), and additional connected-device categories including children's devices and wearables documented in breach and vulnerability reporting.
threshold_application: At least three independent incidents or vulnerabilities exposed collected telemetry in three device categories.
conflict_or_missing_application: One database spanning many Orvibo products was counted once; separate incidents supplied the category breadth.
notes: The result survives conservative incident deduplication.

evidence_summary: macOS Catalina expanded mandatory notarization and runtime checks, while Windows 10 introduced Windows Sandbox and additional default exploit-protection improvements. No authoritative cross-platform indicator established offsetting deterioration.
threshold_application: At least two sampled platforms introduced material hardening or isolation improvements in 2019.
conflict_or_missing_application: Routine patch releases were excluded; notarization enforcement and disposable hardware-isolated environments qualify as architectural changes.
notes: Fulfilled through the platform-change branch.

evidence_summary: Some sources reported declines in conventional malware or malicious-site encounters while others reported growth in trojans, ransomware or endpoint detections; comparable populations and definitions differed.
threshold_application: A majority of three independent comparable sources showing at least a ten-percent decline could not be established.
conflict_or_missing_application: Phishing-only and mobile/IoT series were excluded from the commodity-PC outcome.
notes: Conflicting indicators prevent a binary trend judgment.

evidence_summary: Phishing and business-email-compromise remained prominent and technical account compromise enabled persuasive social engineering, but comparable 2018-2019 series disagree on whether incident counts or shares rose by at least ten percent.
threshold_application: The technical-enablement example exists, but the majority-of-three trend branch is unresolved.
conflict_or_missing_application: Raw report volume and changes in sensor coverage were not treated as incident growth.
notes: The qualitative direction is credible; the quantitative preregistered condition is not proven.

evidence_summary: PSD2 and payment-network rules changed authentication, chargeback and unauthorized-payment responsibility, but two post-talk implemented changes that both materially reallocated fraud liability and explicitly cited fraud-risk allocation could not be cleanly separated from the already announced US EMV shift.
threshold_application: The two-change threshold remains ambiguous under the post-talk exclusion.
conflict_or_missing_application: Authentication mandates without a legal allocation change and pre-announced October 2015 EMV rules were excluded.
notes: Substantial change occurred, but attribution to two qualifying new liability reallocations is uncertain.

evidence_summary: US authorities attributed an Iranian cyber-enabled voter-intimidation operation and separately assessed Russian state-linked influence activity targeting the 2020 election process before election day.
threshold_application: At least one qualifying foreign state-linked attempted operation occurred by 3 November 2020.
conflict_or_missing_application: Ordinary public propaganda was excluded; the Iranian operation used compromised infrastructure and voter data in a targeted campaign.
notes: Clear fulfilment despite no alteration of vote totals.

evidence_summary: The national popular margin coexisted with sub-one-percentage-point outcomes in decisive states including Georgia, Arizona and Wisconsin, while extraordinary litigation, refusal to concede and efforts to overturn certification demonstrate intense division.
threshold_application: At least one frozen close criterion and multiple divisive criteria were met.
conflict_or_missing_application: Closeness was assessed using the preregistered state-level alternative, not only the national popular vote.
notes: Both halves of the conjunctive prediction fulfilled.

evidence_summary: AI and technology ethics became a recognizable employment and professional field, with recurring institutes, conferences and specialist roles across major technology firms, consultancies, universities and civil-society organizations during multiple years.
threshold_application: At least three years contained recurring professional programs and well over five employers advertising specialist work.
conflict_or_missing_application: Generic compliance or responsible-innovation roles were counted only when explicitly devoted to algorithmic, AI or technology ethics.
notes: Fulfilled, though historical job-board counts are less durable than program evidence.

evidence_summary: By the end of 2020 China had interoperating regulatory blacklists, court-enforcement lists and local pilots, but no mandatory nationwide general-population rating or universal citizen score with cross-domain consequences.
threshold_application: The frozen mandatory nationwide general-population threshold was not met.
conflict_or_missing_application: Specific legal blacklists and commercial credit scores were not equated with one general mandatory rating system.
notes: The popularized Black Mirror version did not materialize.

evidence_summary: National identity numbers appeared in many Chinese administrative records, but the prerequisite operative mandatory nationwide person-rating architecture did not exist by the deadline.
threshold_application: The principal-identifier condition cannot be fulfilled without the qualifying nationwide system and was not independently established.
conflict_or_missing_application: Use of an ID number in a sectoral blacklist was not treated as the key of a universal system.
notes: A dependent prediction that fails on its architectural premise.

evidence_summary: China's actual architecture combined national and local mechanisms, but no qualifying mandatory nationwide citizen system was operational by 2020 from which a two-pilot synthesis could be demonstrated.
threshold_application: The prerequisite system and therefore the frozen synthesis threshold were absent.
conflict_or_missing_application: Fragmentation among pilots was not itself counted as synthesis into the predicted mandatory national architecture.
notes: The conditional architectural forecast did not mature by its deadline.

evidence_summary: Some local schools reportedly acted against children of parents on court debt-defaulter lists, but these were overextensions of specific judicial enforcement status, not consequences of a parent's generalized score in the qualifying mandatory national system.
threshold_application: No binding or operational case met all frozen generalized-score and nationwide-system conditions.
conflict_or_missing_application: Debt-judgment enforcement and isolated local experiments were excluded as preregistered.
notes: A widely repeated anecdote does not satisfy the prediction's stronger institutional claim.

evidence_summary: The implemented national architecture consisted principally of sectoral and judicial redlists/blacklists, local rules and inter-agency data platforms, with no universal operative numerical citizen score.
threshold_application: Both decentralized rules-and-data-sharing and absence of a universal citizen score were established by year end.
conflict_or_missing_application: Commercial Sesame Credit and individual city pilots were not mistaken for the national architecture.
notes: A notably accurate corrective to the sensationalized competing forecast.

evidence_summary: The SAFE Act and related federal election-security bills proposed paper-ballot, audit and cybersecurity standards but did not become law during the 116th Congress; appropriations and nonbinding guidance did not create the predicted national mechanism.
threshold_application: No qualifying bill was enacted by 3 January 2021.
conflict_or_missing_application: The IoT Cybersecurity Improvement Act and general cybersecurity statutes were outside the election-specific purpose.
notes: A straightforward legislative non-fulfilment.

evidence_summary: No federal statute principally requiring auditable paper records, post-election audits or equivalent nationwide election-system safeguards was enacted during the Trump administration.
threshold_application: The preregistered negative condition held through 20 January 2021.
conflict_or_missing_application: Election-security grants, agency assistance and unenacted bills were excluded by the frozen rule.
notes: The paired positive forecast in the corpus correspondingly failed.

evidence_summary: Independent testing showed newer products including CrowdStrike and SentinelOne preventing behavior-based and fileless attack chains at levels materially above signature-only baselines and their early-generation positioning.
threshold_application: At least two products met the frozen independent-improvement branch.
conflict_or_missing_application: Vendor claims alone were not used; the judgment relies on comparative attack-chain testing.
notes: Fulfilled as next-generation products entered standardized tests.

evidence_summary: Multiple newer endpoint vendors, including CrowdStrike and SentinelOne, held recognized certifications or awards from independent anti-malware testing organizations by the deadline.
threshold_application: At least two distinct newer vendors met the certification rule.
conflict_or_missing_application: Analyst rankings without an anti-malware test or certification were excluded.
notes: Clear institutional normalization of newer vendors.

evidence_summary: Mainstream EDR/EPP platforms explicitly detected credential theft, script and living-off-the-land abuse, exploit behavior, lateral movement and malicious persistence in addition to malware files.
threshold_application: At least three products covered two or more frozen non-malware classes.
conflict_or_missing_application: Marketing labels were corroborated with MITRE or independent test behaviors.
notes: The predicted scope expansion was firmly established.

evidence_summary: CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Cybereason and other newer vendors unified malware prevention with endpoint control, exploit or script protection, device/firewall management and EDR investigation in common agents and consoles.
threshold_application: At least three vendors met malware prevention plus two traditional EPP-function categories.
conflict_or_missing_application: Separately purchased integrations without a unified product or console were excluded.
notes: A high-confidence convergence result.

evidence_summary: Commercial endpoint-DLP and endpoint-detection platforms from multiple vendors recorded file/object identity and destination or channel evidence sufficient to determine whether and what protected data left an endpoint.
threshold_application: At least two products met the record-or-object attribution rule.
conflict_or_missing_application: Generic alerts that only labeled traffic suspicious were excluded; endpoint DLP object and transfer records qualify.
notes: Fulfilled through converged EDR/DLP platforms, with moderate product-version uncertainty.

evidence_summary: Windows integrated antivirus, firewall, exploit protection and endpoint detection, while macOS integrated Gatekeeper/notarization, XProtect malware controls, firewall and system-integrity protections as default platform functions.
threshold_application: At least two operating-system families each materially provided two listed protective categories without a separate product.
conflict_or_missing_application: Optional enterprise management subscriptions were not required for the underlying built-in protections.
notes: The platform absorbed substantial standalone security functionality.

evidence_summary: Internet Explorer 11 became unsupported for most Windows 10 uses in June 2022 yet retained more than 0.1 percent of measured global browsing during part of the year; other long-obsolete browser versions also persisted in measurable use.
threshold_application: At least one unsupported browser exceeded the frozen 0.1-percent threshold during 2022.
conflict_or_missing_application: Edge IE mode was distinguished from use of the unsupported IE desktop application where the series allowed.
notes: A durable and accurately timed legacy-technology prediction.

evidence_summary: Cyber-insurance premiums grew to a roughly fifteen-billion-dollar global market, but available organizational budget studies place insurance well below one quarter of cybersecurity expenditure and provide no two independent central estimates in the predicted 25-to-33.3-percent band.
threshold_application: The required range was not supported by two qualifying studies by 5 August 2025.
conflict_or_missing_application: Market premium totals were used only as a consistency check, not divided by incomparable global security-market estimates as the primary test.
notes: The forecast substantially overestimated insurance's budget share.

evidence_summary: Official launch and negotiating-mandate materials placed intellectual-property rights among the subjects of the comprehensive TTIP negotiations from their first round.
threshold_application: IP was formally in scope at launch.
conflict_or_missing_application: Later EU textual proposals were not needed to establish the initial mandate.
notes: Fulfilled at the event-bound deadline.

evidence_summary: Contemporaneous USTR launch preparation explicitly sought strong IPR protection and enforcement provisions, and the formal negotiating scope included the IP chapter in that policy context.
threshold_application: At least one official launch-period document placed IP enforcement in scope.
conflict_or_missing_application: General anti-counterfeiting policy was counted only where the document connected it to the imminent TTIP negotiation.
notes: Fulfilled, with less direct textual evidence than the general IP prediction.

evidence_summary: At launch there was a mandate and subject list, not a jointly tabled operative TTIP IP-enforcement treaty text. Consequently no complete launch-day clause could reproduce TPP wording verbatim while also matching ACTA.
threshold_application: No clause met the frozen three-way verbatim and material-analogy test at launch.
conflict_or_missing_application: Later negotiating proposals and leaked TPP text were excluded because the deadline was the first official negotiation day.
notes: The prediction overreached from agenda inclusion to textual copying.
